memos.argument: The goods are pipe of brass (copper-zinc alloy), described as seamless and ERW, with stated OD and wall thickness: the classic subject of 'Copper tubes and pipes'. Subheading 7411.21 covers brass, with 7411.21.10 for seamless; ERW pipe would fall in 7411.21.50 (Other). Heading text has no end-use limitation; decoration of the end use does not change the form. Chapter 74 note 1 and subheading note define brass consistent with copper-zinc. Mixed seamless/ERW means the 10-digit split is uncertain (seamless 7411.21.10.00 vs other 7411.21.50.00).
exclusions_against: No cited ruling found on brass tube; cross_search returned only fittings and candleholders
Section XV note 1 and ch.74 notes contain no exclusion that removes plain tube from 7411
If the goods are cut/finished into decorative articles (railings, furniture parts) heading 7418/7419 or ch.94 may displace
ERW portion maps to 7411.21.50.00 rather than the seamless line

memos.argument: Decorative use might make the pipe an article for household/table use under 7418 only if it is dedicated to such use; the stated use is merely decorative. Best available line is 7418.10.00 (household articles) with brass sub-line 7418.10.00.02 for brass. Weak case: heading 7418 is limited to table, kitchen or other household articles and sanitary ware, and plain pipe of stock sizes (2in, 1.5in OD, 0.40in wall) is semi-finished material, not a finished household article.
exclusions_against: Heading text limited to table, kitchen, household articles, sanitary ware; undefined decorative pipe is not one
H201157 (brass escutcheons, decorative) went to 7419.99.50, not 7418, and is about a finished trim part, so it does not support 7418
Specific form heading 7411 (tubes and pipes) beats use-based 7418 under GRI 1 and 3(a)
Candleholder rulings (F87429 etc.) went to 9405, showing decorative brass articles scatter outside ch.74

memos.argument: If the pipe were imported cut to length and threaded or otherwise adapted as couplings, elbows, sleeves, it would be 'Of copper alloys' under 7412.20.00. Rulings place brass pipe/tube fittings there. But the description presents pipe in 2in/1.5in OD lengths, not fittings.
exclusions_against: Description says pipe, not fittings; heading 7412 covers fittings (couplings, elbows, sleeves) only
Both cited rulings concern threaded pneumatic fittings/connectors, factually distinct from raw pipe
Plain tube is covered by 7411, so 7412 yields to it
